metadata.name: Ice & Snow Profile – NM01_04_S01 (29 Dec 2004, –70.65491°, –8.25491°)
metadata.description: Dataset of 53 ice and snow core observations collected on 29 December 2004 at a single Antarctic site (latitude -70.65491°, longitude -8.25491°). Each record includes a unique sample identifier, depth of ice/snow (m), ice density (g cm⁻³), and an optional depth description (missing for 24 of the 53 rows). Constant metadata (event code, acquisition date, location) and a reference image (NM01_04_S01.png) are also provided.
